packageRules.description: Regenerate docs/compatibility.md on the bot's own branch after any gomod or mise bump — the committed matrix is generated from versions.yaml + go.mod, and CI's validate job fails on drift (sync-versions.sh check). Dependabot could not run this step, which left its PRs permanently red (#665, #667). The script is a no-op when nothing derived changes, so matching both managers is safe.

Flux minors are capped at the current series, preserving the intent of the retired Dependabot ignore rules: a fluxcd minor moves supported_range and the API surface together (see versions.yaml notes) and must be a deliberate coordinated upgrade, not a bot proposal. Dashboard-gated rather than disabled so the pending series stays visible. Majors are already gated org-wide by the shared preset.
